name: Powerbuilding
description: Strength and size together, four days a week for 12 weeks. Each day starts heavy on one of the squat, bench press, deadlift or overhead press and finishes with higher-rep work for muscle. The main lifts get heavier from block to block while the accessories stay in the eight to fifteen range; week 9 is a deload.

phases.name: Base
phases.description: Moderate main lifts, plenty of accessory volume

phases.name: Build
phases.description: Heavier main lifts, one more set on the accessories

phases.name: Deload
phases.description: One lighter week: fewer sets and lighter weights, so you start the next phase recovered

phases.name: Peak
phases.description: Heavy doubles and triples first, then the accessories
